# Season 2 boss abilities

**Generated by `extract.py` -- do not hand-edit the spell IDs.** They are read out
of the BigWigs/LittleWigs modules the game actually loads. Re-run the script after
any boss-mod update and diff.

The one column that IS yours to edit is **Healer action**. The `Class` column is a
first pass derived from BigWigs' own role flags and is wrong wherever the flags
don't happen to line up with what a healer does. Overwrite it.
